edge.title: Power-1.5 LR decay with floors; stop at 3040 of a 3125-step schedule
edge.summary: Keeps #19's KL-SOAP-H optimizer and replaces both linear decays with a floored power law: η = floor + (1−floor)·x^1.5 with x = (1 − step/3125)/cooldown_frac, using floor 0.017 for the KL-SOAP matrices (decaying from step 0) and 0.04 for aux AdamW (decaying over the last 40%). Training stops at 3040 steps while the schedule horizon stays at 3125, so the final steps still run at ≈2.1% (hidden) and ≈5.7% (aux) of peak LR instead of annealing to 0. All of these values were injected via env vars at launch; the logged code's defaults (3150 steps, power 1.0, zero floors, shampoo_beta 0.95) are not what ran.

changes.label: Power-law cooldown with LR floors
changes.detail: _eta(progress, cooldown_frac, power, floor) = 1 before the cooldown, else floor + (1−floor)·x^power with x = max(0, (1−progress)/cooldown_frac); runs use LR_POWER = 1.5, KLSOAP_LR_FLOOR = 0.017, ADAM_LR_FLOOR = 0.04 with cooldown fracs 1.0 / 0.4 unchanged.

changes.label: Schedule horizon decoupled from run
changes.detail: progress = step/SCHEDULE_STEPS with SCHEDULE_STEPS = 3125 while TRAIN_STEPS = 3040, so training ends 85 steps before the schedule would finish.

changes.label: Steps 3125→3040
changes.detail: train_steps = TRAIN_STEPS = 3040, which is also the claimed step (final eval).

changes.label: Env-driven config and plumbing
changes.detail: All schedule/KL-SOAP hparams read from env with 'Using …' prints (KLSOAPH default shampoo_beta changed to 0.95, but runs pass 0.9); SEED env (manual_seed only) replaces KL_SOAP_SEED; cuDNN SDPA disabled; LOG_DIR, extra eval steps and optional progress prints.

mechanisms.name: Power-law cooldown with LR floors
mechanisms.explain: Each group's multiplier is 1 until progress = step/3125 reaches 1 − cooldown_frac, then floor + (1−floor)·x^1.5, where x is the remaining fraction of the cooldown. With power > 1 the LR drops faster early in the cooldown and flattens near the end; the floors (1.7% of peak for KL-SOAP, 4% for AdamW) and stopping at step 3040 of the 3125-step horizon keep the final LRs non-zero.

caveats: The logged script is env-driven and its defaults (TRAIN_STEPS 3150, SCHEDULE_STEPS = TRAIN_STEPS, LR_POWER 1.0, floors 0, KLSOAP_SHAMPOO_BETA 0.95) do not reproduce the record. All five logs print train_steps=3040, schedule_steps=3125, lr_power=1.5, adam_lr_floor=0.04, klsoap_lr_floor=0.017, klsoap_shampoo_beta=0.9, matching the README and the archived hard-coded script, so those values are used here. The README says the script reads KL_SOAP_SEED; that is true of the archived script, while the logged one reads SEED.
